what: Unit suite executed inside the pinned official CHIA image, read-only mount, no simulator run.
command: sudo docker run --rm -e OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 -v /tmp/imgtest2:/work:ro -w /work ghcr.io/ucb-bar/chia-champsim@sha256:610951d382f9e6cdfc51a4526ba70e36c80f3375b1dc19d60117bc47f20e94c4 python3 -m unittest discover -s chia_loop/tests
host: GCP compute instance chia-grid2, us-east1-b (sponsor-funded project, compute idle at run time)
tree_tested: chia_loop/ and scripts/ from the working tree after defect 8 (the harness substituting a candidate for a missing factor level) was closed and its regression test added; 33 Python files, 9 of them test modules, shipped as a tarball, extracted into a fresh /tmp/imgtest2 and mounted read-only. The VM working tree was not touched and nothing on it was deleted.
supersedes: results/in_image_tests_2026-09-23.json recorded 'Ran 43 tests / OK' against the tree before the 44th test existed. 43 was correct then; that file is kept as the record of the earlier commit.
note: The suite is pure Python and does not exercise the simulator; running it in the image establishes interpreter and dependency compatibility, not that any measurement reproduced.
method_note: The first attempt reported files=0 for the extracted tree and a docker permission error. Both were measurement artefacts, not state: the count came from a find pattern mangled by nested quoting, and the daemon socket needs sudo for this account. Re-checked with a heredoc script on the remote host, which showed 33 files extracted. A zero from your own probe is a harness-bug hypothesis before it is a finding.
